content: {"question":"How many weeks of Paid Family Leave can a New York employee take in a 52‑week period?","answer":"Up to 12 weeks of leave, and the maximum time‑off benefit can be taken in any given 52‑week period.","evidence":"Eligible employees may take up to 12 weeks of leave. This leave can be taken either all at once or intermittently, but must be taken in full‑day increments. You may take the maximum time‑off benefit in any given 52‑week period."}
